item.title: DevOps / SRE Engineer — 4ALL
item.description:
Technology company.

  • Infrastructure as code: several Terraform projects for AWS environments.
  • Implementation and administration of Kubernetes clusters (EKS) across different AWS accounts, with multiple components.
  • Platform operation automation at the pipeline level, built with Shell Script and Python.
  • Systems and infrastructure observability with Prometheus, Grafana and CloudWatch — latency, 4xx/5xx errors, memory usage, request volume.
  • Docker and Docker Compose for infrastructure development environments; internal Shell Script tool released as open source (cid).
  • CI/CD with Git/GitLab.
  • Full infrastructure automation cycle with Packer, Terraform and Ansible for AWS using GitLab.

item.title: DevOps Engineer — Sicredi
item.description:
Working on site for Sicredi.

  • Python scripts with Boto3 for AWS.

item.title: DevOps Engineer — PoaTek (AGCO)
item.description:
Working on site for AGCO (Agriculture Corporation).

  • Deployment and infrastructure automation with Docker, Docker Compose, Bash and Puppet.
  • Continuous integration with Git, Bitbucket and Bamboo.
  • Logs and metrics with Elasticsearch, Logstash, Grafana, Telegraf and InfluxDB.
  • Development environment automation with VirtualBox, Vagrant, Packer, Linux and Preseed.
  • Job scheduler (Rundeck) and build tools (Gradle, Apache Maven).
  • Linux server administration (Ubuntu Server) and process documentation for developers.
  • Participation in special projects implementing new tools.
